::: {#def-no-interference .theorem}
## No interference assumption 

The assumption that no variable in a given [observational unit](#def-observational-unit) is a [parent](#def-parent-child) of a [non-equivalent](#def-equivalence) variable in another unit.


$$
X\notin \mathbf{Pa}(Y)\quad
\forall\, X\in \mathscr O_i,\ Y\in \mathscr O_j,\ X\not\sim Y \ i\ne j
$$
:::
